primitives.name: Cocos Dashboard
primitives.install: Download Cocos Dashboard from https://www.cocos.com/en/creator-download, then install the editor version below from it
primitives.license: Cocos Creator EULA (proprietary, no SPDX identifier)

primitives.name: Cocos Creator 3.8.8
primitives.install: Cocos Dashboard > Editor > install 3.8.8 (released 16 Dec 2025). Build headless with: CocosCreator --project <path> --build "configPath=<build-config.json>"
primitives.license: Cocos Creator EULA (proprietary, no SPDX identifier)

primitives.name: cocos-creator-mcp (harady)
primitives.install: Copy into <project>/extensions/cocos-creator-mcp at tag v2.0.0, run npm install && npm run build there, enable in Extension Manager, Start Server, then: claude mcp add --transport http cocos-creator http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp

primitives.name: Node.js LTS (for editor extensions and logic tests)
primitives.install: Install the current Node.js LTS (TODO(verify: the 3.8 manual names no Node version for the editor's extension toolchain))

primitives.name: Vitest (logic unit tests outside the editor)
primitives.install: npm install -D vitest@<pinned version> (current major is 5, 5.1.0 on 2026-11-15, which needs Node 22.12 or later)

primitives.name: Playwright (drive web builds headless)
primitives.install: npm install -D @playwright/test@<pinned version> && npx playwright install chromium
